result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The environment is cluttered with utility poles and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines and narrow the effective walking space at the corner.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole and parked vehicles near the corner block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner and right side of the street

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt within the crossing area and near the curb ramp creates a potential tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface within the crosswalk area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is situated beneath an elevated rail structure, which introduces significant visual obstructions via large support pillars. While basic infrastructure like marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks are present, the wide roadway and lack of pedestrian refuge islands increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Elevated Rail Pillars
hazards.description: Large steel support pillars for the overhead rail structure are positioned near the intersection, significantly blocking sightlines between turning vehicles and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line and within the roadway area on the left and center.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires a long exposure time for pedestrians crossing the street without any mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The main zebra crossing spanning the width of the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corners to reduce crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight past the pillars.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light, increasing visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages and provide a safe waiting area.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by an elevated rail structure whose support pillars create significant visual obstructions at the intersection. While basic infrastructure like marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals are present, the wide roadway and complex sightlines prioritize vehicle movement over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Infrastructure Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large steel support pillars for the elevated rail line are positioned near the intersection corners, creating significant blind spots between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground, supporting the blue overhead structure

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane thoroughfare increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the width of the main roadway under the elevated tracks

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstructions
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection further restrict visibility for pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and move pedestrians into a more visible position beyond the support pillars.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve sightlines between motorists and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing their visibility in the intersection.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, but the environment is dominated by an elevated rail structure that creates significant shadows and visual complexity. While traffic signals are present, there is a lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the pavement markings are noticeably faded.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Complexity from Elevated Structure
hazards.description: The large blue steel structure creates deep shadows and a cluttered visual field, potentially masking pedestrians from drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, overhanging the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signalized corners

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Realignment
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.
